plan.confirmationPolicy: Repeat every successful W16 and W12 seed-11 configuration on seeds 17 and 23 with the same full epoch budget. W14 confirmations were stopped when the user restricted further work to W16; retain only completed trials.

refinements.reason: Fill learning-rate gaps at W12 before deciding whether a smaller width merits further work.
Four previously queued trials had completed when the lower-width queue was stopped. Retain this historical evidence without scheduling further W10 work.

plan.selection: Report widths with one fixed learning rate and weight decay reaching 99% test accuracy on all three seeds; rank confirmed configurations by worst-seed crossing epoch, then median. Incomplete W14 confirmation coverage cannot establish a lower bound.
plan.stopDecision: W12 had no configuration confirmed on all three seeds. The user stopped further work below W12 and then restricted all subsequent trials to W16. Completed earlier results are retained; interrupted trials do not count as failures.

execution.reuse: Conclusive W16 runs from the existing optimizer searches; retain original histories, arguments and binary hashes.

scope: Smallest width confirmed in the retained finite search; incomplete W14 confirmations and the epoch budget prevent a mathematical lower-bound claim.
